description: This file contains a script for creating database migration files by comparing the current database schema with a Prisma schema. It uses testing.postgresql to spin up a temporary PostgreSQL instance, executes Prisma CLI commands to deploy migrations and generate diffs, handles filesystem operations for copying and cleaning directories, and writes the resulting migration SQL to a file.

methods.name: create_migration(migration_name: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a new migration SQL file by comparing the current database state with the Prisma schema, optionally taking a migration name as input. Sets up a temporary PostgreSQL instance, copies existing migrations, applies migrations, generates a schema diff, and writes the migration to a timestamped directory.

ctags.name: migration_name
ctags.pattern: /^    migration_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None$/

fields.name: migration_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
